project: シフトうさぎ（A案：介護夜勤 × 目が死んだ白ウサギ）
target: 介護施設の夜勤スタッフ（特養・老健・グループホーム）
art_direction: ゆるかわ系だが目が完全に死んでいる3頭身の白ウサギ
layout_rule: テキストは画像の上側。キャラは下寄せ。生成時は上部30%を空白として確保する。

text_spec.font: Zen Maru Gothic Bold (ZenMaruGothic-Bold.ttf / SIL OFL)

stamps.action_en: bowing slightly forward with one paw placed on its chest.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded lifeless eyes, mouth a flat horizontal line.

stamps.action_en: standing tilted to one side, raising one paw in a small wave at chest height.
stamps.expression_en: heavy drooping eyelids, suppressing a yawn, mouth slightly puckered.

stamps.action_en: standing straight, pointing at the blank white name badge on its chest with one paw.
stamps.expression_en: blank resolute stare, completely dead eyes, mouth a flat line.

stamps.action_en: body melted and collapsed onto the floor like liquid, both arms limp and spread on the ground.
stamps.expression_en: total emptiness, dot eyes staring down at an angle, mouth a tiny slack line.

stamps.action_en: making a small OK sign with one paw at chest height, body facing front.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, mouth pursed into a tiny "n" shape.

stamps.text: ありがとうございます
stamps.action_en: both paws pressed together in front of its chest, leaning slightly forward.
stamps.expression_en: dead eyes, but a faint upward curve at the corners of the mouth.

stamps.action_en: one paw held up flat beside its face, body shrunk and turned at an angle.
stamps.expression_en: no eyebrows, dot eyes shifted to the side in panic, tiny open mouth.

stamps.action_en: seen from the side, running with one hind foot lifted, motion lines only horizontal.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes looking forward, mouth a flat line.

stamps.action_en: seen from behind, walking away, raising one paw small in farewell.
stamps.expression_en: face hidden from view, both ears drooping limply downward.

stamps.action_en: holding a small clipboard at chest height with both paws, nodding.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, chin tucked in, mouth a flat line.

stamps.action_en: standing alone and very small on a wide empty floor, generous empty space all around it.
stamps.expression_en: flat frontal stare, all emotion drained, mouth a flat line.

stamps.action_en: crouching down, both paws clamped over its ears; small jagged sound marks spread horizontally on both sides at body height only.
stamps.expression_en: eyes squeezed tightly shut, mouth a trembling wavy line.

stamps.action_en: seen from the side, tiptoeing carefully while holding a small penlight low.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, mouth pressed tight.

stamps.action_en: holding a large blank sheet of paper and a pen with both paws, hands frozen and still.
stamps.expression_en: dot eyes locked on the paper, fully expressionless.

stamps.action_en: sitting shallowly on a folding chair, upper body slumped sideways.
stamps.expression_en: eyes rolled back into near-white, mouth hanging half open.

stamps.action_en: standing, but the body folded into a sharp angle at the waist, only the feet planted on the ground.
stamps.expression_en: heavy dark eye bags strongly emphasized, half-lidded, mouth a flat line.

stamps.action_en: holding one small clenched fist in front of its chest, standing upright.
stamps.expression_en: dead eyes, but both ears standing perked straight up — the only sign of joy.

stamps.action_en: glancing sideways up at a small wall clock, shoulders dropped completely.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, corners of the mouth turned down.

stamps.action_en: both paws pressed to its lower back, upper body locked sideways; small red radiating impact marks at waist height.
stamps.expression_en: eyes screwed shut, teeth clenched.

stamps.action_en: both arms stretched out to opposite left and right sides, body torn in the middle.
stamps.expression_en: dot eyes drifting apart in opposite directions, mouth a small wobbly line.

stamps.action_en: a towel around its neck, sweat droplets flying sideways off its body horizontally.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, mouth open in an exhausted "ha".

stamps.action_en: seen from the side, hurrying while carrying a big armful of folded towels.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes fixed forward, zero emotion.

stamps.action_en: both palms turned upward and spread lightly, stopped at shoulder height.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, mouth a small wavy line.

stamps.text: 検温まだ終わってない
stamps.action_en: holding a single thermometer, body completely frozen in place.
stamps.expression_en: dot eyes drifting off to the side.

stamps.text: 委員会の資料、できてません
stamps.action_en: seen from the side, frozen while holding a thick stack of documents between waist and chest height.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, gaze fully averted.

stamps.action_en: one paw pressed to its lower back, body bent at the waist, the other paw braced against a wall.
stamps.expression_en: no eyebrows, half-lidded, mouth pressed into a hard flat line.

stamps.action_en: one paw held daintily near its mouth, head tilted slightly, elegant polite posture.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded dead eyes combined with a bright cheerful smiling mouth — maximum contrast.

stamps.action_en: one empty open palm turned upward at chest height, body kept low in the frame.
stamps.expression_en: dot eyes gazing vacantly upward, mouth slightly open.

stamps.action_en: perfectly rigid standing pose, both arms pressed flat against its sides, zero movement.
stamps.expression_en: dot eyes only — the mouth line is completely removed.

stamps.text: 笑顔だけは死んでない
stamps.action_en: both paws cupped against its cheeks in a cute smiling pose.
stamps.expression_en: a wide beaming happy smile on the mouth while the eyes stay completely dead and half-lidded.

stamps.action_en: still wearing the name badge, body shifted half a step sideways toward a door.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, mouth in a small rounded pout.

stamps.action_en: holding a small envelope with both paws at chest height, looking down at it.
stamps.expression_en: dot eyes fixed on the envelope, mouth perfectly straight.

stamps.text: 私、何の仕事してたっけ
stamps.action_en: one paw on its head, tilting slightly; small question marks placed horizontally beside it at body height.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, completely out of focus.

stamps.action_en: arms spread lightly, shoulders shrugged up to shoulder height.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, one corner of the mouth barely raised.

stamps.action_en: giving a small thumbs-up at chest height.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, ears slightly perked.

stamps.action_en: seen from the side, reaching one small paw out toward something off-frame.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, mouth firmly closed, serious.

stamps.action_en: leaning slightly forward, one paw extended in a comforting gesture.
stamps.expression_en: no eyebrows, half-lidded, mouth in a small downturned curve.

stamps.action_en: both paws lightly stacked in front of its chest, body tilted a little.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes, faint upward curve of the mouth.

stamps.action_en: bowing deeply, both paws placed on its knees, upper body folded forward.
stamps.expression_en: face angled down, only one half-lidded eye visible.

stamps.action_en: holding out a small fist at shoulder height as if offering a fist bump.
stamps.expression_en: half-lidded eyes looking straight ahead, mouth a flat line.
